title: Arnold DePass's band: Picklehead Marrero and the trombonists
summary: De De recalls trombone and banjo men in Arnold DePass's band, including Marrero nicknamed Picklehead, and Sonny Henry who sent men out to jobs.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well, if we can get off the subject of French, I'd like to get back to jazz a little bit. Just for a moment. Pardon me. Who played with Arnold De Passa's band? I was wondering about that.
I told you.
Trombone and banjo. I didn't hear.
Trombone, banjo. At one time, this boy, he worked with us a lot too. It was called Picklehead. He just died lately there. Remember George Lewis? What's his name?
Marrera.
Marrera.

I hope to tell you.
